translations.web: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.
translations.bsb: By His power God raised the Lord from the dead, and He will raise us also.
translations.kjv: And God hath ➔ both raised up the Lord, and ➔ will ➔ also raise up us by his own power.
translations.asv: and God both raised the Lord, and will raise up as through his power.
